class_id.description: Stable identifier of the class. Entries derive their class from their key, so this never changes.

version.description: Semver of this descriptor. A change to erase_on or restoration_route is a major change.

name.description: Human-recognisable name, used where the product states what sign-out or account deletion erases.

key_pattern.description: Key shape claimed by this class, in the segments of the naming scheme. Patterns may not overlap.

owner.description: Capability path accountable for writing and reading entries of this class.

replicates.description: Whether entries of this class belong to the account's replicated set.

restoration_route.description: How an unreadable entry of this class is replaced. Constrained by INV-PLT-06.

erase_on.description: Events that erase entries of this class. sign_out, device_revocation, account_deletion and uninstall are mandatory for every class.

metadata_fields.description: Exhaustive list of non-secret fields the class may hold beside the ciphertext, readable without decrypting.

expected_size.description: Optional size range entries are expected to occupy, used for store sizing.

notes.description: Optional rationale for a reader of the registry who did not write the class.
